plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Business, AA' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/business-aa/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid (Business Career Map), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. Grid rows shown only as a footnote number with units do not name a specific course in the published schedule — modeled as choice slots with the catalog's footnote number preserved in choice_note; catalog footnote 4 = 'See approved General Education list for the AA/AS Degree', footnote 5 = 'See program recommendations or requirements'; see advisor. BUS 176 may be taken in lieu of MATH 176 for TMCC business degrees but is not guaranteed to transfer to other NSHE institutions including UNR. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid. This program can be completed online but may require in-person assignments or exams; a Business FastTrack one-year/two-year online format is also offered.
